directive.quote: finish the trillion-launch-video port so the repo can be retired and renamed trillion-launch-video-completely-ported

targets.baseline_commit_message: media-composition: byte copies of the three local sound-effect model scripts

preserve: the pipeline loads once in bfloat16 on mps when there is one
one candidate per seed at the given steps and length
a candidate already written is not made again
each candidate's prompt, seed, steps, length and wall time are written beside it
allowed_deltas: one prompt per run (the style's input) instead of every prompt of a prompts file
weights folder, output folder, steps, first seed and count are arguments; the log is a .json beside each file
banned_substitutions: a second sound-effect runner beside make-pictures-and-sounds.mjs
